paper_title: QBugLM: An Agentic Benchmarking Framework for LLM-based Quantum Software Debugging
reason: 이 논문은 양자 소프트웨어 디버깅(OpenQASM 3.0 버그 탐지·수리)을 위한 에이전트 프레임워크 QBugLM을 제안한다. 벤치마크 과제가 양자 회로 코드(OpenQASM)이며 한국어/영어 자연어 지식·추론·코딩·에이전트·멀티모달·장문 평가 범주에 해당하지 않는다. 사례 연구는 5개 양자 회로에 주입한 버그에 대한 두 LLM의 Pass@k만 측정한 소규모 케이스 스터디로, 재사용 가능한 한국어/영어 벤치마크를 새로 도입하거나 기존 항목을 실질적으로 갱신하지 않는다. 따라서 인벤토리 범위 밖으로 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: QBugLM: An Agentic Benchmarking Framework for LLM-based Quantum Software Debugging
screening.abstract: Quantum software bugs often yield silent, incorrect outputs rather than explicit errors, making them particularly difficult to detect and repair with conventional techniques. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on classical software engineering tasks, their ability to debug quantum code remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose QBugLM, a multi-agent framework that automates the quantum software debugging pipeline, from taxonomy-driven bug injection to LLM-based detection and repair, and finally to simulation-based validation, for framework-agnostic OpenQASM 3.0 programs. We further conduct a comprehensive case study using QBugLM to benchmark two LLMs, Claude 4.6 Sonnet and Qwen3 Coder Next, across different prompting strategies, bug categories, and quantum programs. Our results show that iterative feedback is critical, as a single retry raises Pass@1 from below 25% to above 80%. Moreover, simpler structured prompting can even outperform Chain-of-Thought and ReAct for reasoning-capable models under fixed-resource constraints. Our work takes initial steps toward benchmarking LLM capabilities for debugging quantum programs and offers practical insights to support future efforts in automated quantum software repair.
